## Vireo v0.13.0

This release focuses on code intelligence: more flexible, safer edits and anchors, plus performance work across the backend and UI.

### Highlights

- **More robust anchors.** Edits can now target plain lines and snippets, and anchors are disambiguated with line snippets so repeated lines no longer resolve to the wrong place (`d1a48a4`, `1e0cde9`).
- **Safer, richer editing.** Hunks-only edits, live anchor relocation as files change, and atomic edit journals make multi-step edits more reliable (`1e0cde9`).
- **Remote branch pruning.** Prune stale remote branches directly from the git UI (`79ab544`).
- **Graceful shutdown.** Child processes are now shut down cleanly when the app exits (`5a1180a`).

### Performance

- Fewer repeated passes and allocations in patch and search paths.
- Faster UI rendering.
- New backend and frontend performance benchmarks (`19a3dd0`).

### Documentation

- README checksums updated for v0.12.1, screenshots refreshed, and theme count corrected (`a923c58`, `e60ca0e`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.12.1...v0.13.0
